## Welcome to Mount Olivet Cemetery

The Mount Olivet Cemetery made history in 1907 when it became the first perpetual care cemetery in the South. Located in the legendary Northside of Fort Worth, this 130-acre cemetery is the resting place of many of Fort Worth's most notables, including settlers, government and business leaders, known and unknown military heroes, and the backbone of this historic community...its hard-working people.

Upon entering the cemetery you will be immediately greeted by a sense of peace that surrounds the elegant garden entrance. And as you continue throughout the manicured grounds, you will want to pay special attention to the magnificent sculptures, the stately trees, and the peaceful "Swan Lake" that grace these hallowed grounds, and add year-round beauty for the thousands of families that return to honor and to remember.

Mount Olivet Cemetery and Greenwood Memorial Park...

Fort Worth's Most Beautiful, and Convenient Perpetual-Care Cemeteries.
